newsitem.title: JAPAN: Matsushita says develops super-thin digital camera.
newsitem.headline: Matsushita says develops super-thin digital camera.

text.p: Matsushita Electric Industrial Co on Friday unveiled a super-thin digital still camera, which the company said can be easily connected to television screens to view the pictures.
The new camera is 21 mm thick and weighs only 140 grams, Matsushita said in a statement.
Its pictures can be viewed on a personal computer as well as on a TV screen, when connected to the camera via the supplied cable, Matsushita said.

Matsushita, whose products are sold under the "National", "Panasonics," and "Technics" brand names, will begin sales in Japan in March 20 at a price of 49,800 yen. It plans monthly production of 10,000 units initially, the company said.
Shipments to the U.S. market will begin in April, a company spokeswoman said.
